output.reply: I'm sorry to hear your top-up was cancelled. If the payment was not completed, no money will be taken from your account, so no refund is needed. If the funds were deducted, the amount should be released back to your account automatically, though this can take a few working days depending on your bank. If you don't see the funds returned after that time, please let us know and we'll be happy to look into it for you.

For transactions in a foreign currency, we apply the exchange rate set on the day the payment is processed, which includes a small conversion margin. You can view the current rate and any applicable fees in your banking app or on our website before confirming a transaction. If you tell me which currency and type of transaction you have in mind, I can point you to the right details.

Cash deposits usually appear on your account the same day or by the next business day. Please check your recent transactions first. If it's still missing, visit or call the branch where you made the deposit with your deposit slip or receipt — they can trace it using the transaction date, amount, and till reference. Once confirmed, the deposit will be credited to your account.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience. We'll check the status of your deposit right away. Please confirm the deposit date, amount, and the branch or location where you made it, and we'll review it and get back to you promptly.

I'm sorry to hear that — an unrecognized charge can be concerning. Please freeze or block your card immediately in the app or by contacting us, note the date and amount of the charge, and review your recent transactions for any others you don't recognize. We'll then open a dispute on the charge and investigate it with you.

You can update most personal details (such as your address, phone number, or email) by logging into online or mobile banking and visiting the Profile or Settings section. If a change requires additional verification—such as your name or date of birth—please contact us via secure message or visit a branch with valid ID, and we'll guide you through the process.

You can update your personal details directly in your app or online banking under Profile/Settings. If you need to change your legal name, date of birth, or address, please also upload a supporting document, and our team will review it within a few working days. Let us know if you need help locating the section.

Thanks for reaching out. We ask for this information to protect you and your account against fraud and identity theft, and to meet legal and regulatory requirements (such as anti-money laundering rules). The details we collect — like your name, date of birth, address, and ID documents — help us confirm you are who you say you are before granting access to your accounts. We only collect what is necessary, and we keep it secure and confidential. If you have concerns about a specific document or piece of information we've requested, please let us know and we can explain why it's needed.

For security reasons, we're unable to tell you your PIN over the phone. You can view your PIN securely in our mobile app or online banking under 'Card settings' — simply select your new card and choose 'View PIN' (you may need to verify your identity with biometrics or a passcode). Alternatively, you can set your own PIN at any of our ATMs by selecting 'Change PIN'. If you don't see this option, please let us know and we'll look into it.

You can set or change your PIN through your mobile app or online banking under Card Settings, or by calling the number on the back of your card. If you'd like, I can walk you through the steps or help you find the nearest branch or ATM where you can set it in person.

You can view your PIN securely in our mobile app by selecting your card, then 'View PIN'. You can also view it at any of our ATMs by choosing the 'View PIN' option. For security, please never share your PIN with anyone, including bank staff.

I can help with that. We can arrange a Mastercard for you — please confirm your preferred card type (debit or credit) and whether you'd like a physical card, and we'll check the options available on your account.

I'm sorry to hear the exchange rate applied to your card payment doesn't look right. Card payments made in a foreign currency are converted at the rate set by the card scheme (e.g., Visa or Mastercard) on the transaction date, which may differ slightly from the daily published rate. If you'd like us to review the specific transaction, please provide the date, amount, currency, and the last four digits of the card, and our team will check it and get back to you with the details.

You can top up by card in our app or online banking: go to Top Up, choose Debit/Credit Card, enter the amount and your card details, then confirm the payment. The funds should appear in your account shortly after the payment is approved. If you don't see a top-up by card option, please let us know which channel you're using so we can help further.

Yes, in most cases others can send money to your account. They can do this by bank transfer to your account details (sort code and account number), or via any top-up methods we offer, such as debit card transfers where available. Please share only your account number and sort code with people you trust, and never share your login details or one-time codes. If you'd like, we can also explain how to set up a regular payment request or standing order from them.

The number of disposable cards you can create at once depends on your account type and current settings. Please check the card section of your app for your available limit, or contact us so we can confirm the exact number for your account.

Yes, you can freeze your card immediately. The quickest way is to open your mobile app or online banking, go to your card settings, and select 'freeze card' — this instantly blocks new payments while keeping your account open. If you don't have app access, please call our card services line and we can help you secure it right away. If you believe your card has been lost or stolen, let us know so we can block it permanently and arrange a replacement.

I'm sorry to hear the exchange rate on your card payment seems off. Foreign card payments are converted using the live interbank exchange rate at the moment the payment is processed, and a small exchange fee may apply. If you can share the date, amount, and currency of the payment, our team can review the conversion and explain the rate that was applied.

If you're asking where your card can be used: any ATM displaying the same network logo as the one printed on your card (or shown in your app under Card details) will accept it. Check the logo on the machine before inserting your card, and note that other networks' ATMs may charge an additional fee. If you'd like, tell me which logo appears on your card and I can point you in the right direction.
I can help you find your nearest ATM. Please share your location or postcode, and I'll provide the distance and directions from our nearest ATM to you.

Thank you for letting us know about this unfamiliar direct deposit. Please check with the sender (such as an employer or government agency) to confirm the payment was intended for you, and review your transaction history for any details. If you still don't recognize it or suspect fraudulent activity, please let us know right away so we can secure your account and investigate with our fraud team.

I'm sorry to hear you've misplaced your password. For your security, you can reset it anytime using the 'Forgotten password' link on our app or website — you'll be asked a few identity checks before setting a new one. If you don't receive the reset details, or you suspect someone else may have accessed your details, please let us know and we'll secure your account right away.

I'm sorry you weren't able to get cash. This can happen if the ATM is out of service or has run out of cash, your daily withdrawal limit was reached, or the transaction was declined for security reasons. Please check your available balance and daily limit in your banking app, try a different ATM, and let us know the date, time, location, and amount so we can investigate the transaction for you.

Declines at an ATM can happen for a number of reasons, such as insufficient funds, daily withdrawal limits, exceeding your available balance, or a temporary security restriction. I can't see the specific reason from here, but please check your account balance and recent transactions, and if nothing explains it, contact us so we can review the card for any blocks or restrictions.

Thanks for reaching out! Most card payments complete automatically once the merchant finishes processing the transaction — this can sometimes take a few days. If a payment is still showing as pending after that time, please let us know the details and we'll look into it for you. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thank you for reaching out. Payments can take a few business days to appear, depending on the type of transfer and when it was submitted. You can check the status of the payment in your transaction history, where it will typically show as pending until it is completed. If it has been longer than the expected processing time for that payment type, please let us know the date and amount, and we'll be happy to look into it further.

I'm sorry to hear that. If your phone is lost or stolen, we recommend contacting your mobile provider to block your SIM as soon as possible. You can also reach our fraud/support team to discuss securing your account and mobile banking access.

I'm sorry to hear about your lost phone. To protect your accounts, please freeze your cards and disable mobile access immediately using the app on another device if available, or contact us right away so we can secure your profile and help you re-register on a new device.

Sorry to hear your phone is lost. Yes — you can still access your account: log in from another device or computer using your usual details, and if you've lost access to your registered mobile number or authentication app, please contact us straight away so we can help secure your account and update your security settings.

Sorry to hear that! Since your phone may have banking apps or saved payment details, we recommend contacting your hotel immediately and calling us right away so we can help secure your accounts and monitor for any unauthorized activity.

I'm sorry you need to return an item. If it was purchased with your card, the merchant handles the return directly—please contact them to start the process. Once they process it, a refund will be credited back to your card, usually within 5–10 business days. If the merchant has already confirmed a refund but it hasn't appeared, let us know and we can look into it for you.

Even when transfer details are correct, a transfer can still be declined for other reasons — for example, insufficient funds or an exceeded daily transfer limit on your account, a restriction or block on your account, the recipient's bank rejecting the payment (such as an account closure or name mismatch at their end), or enhanced fraud/security checks. We'd recommend checking your account balance and limits, and contacting your recipient's bank to confirm their details are still valid. If you'd like, we can look into the specific decline reason for you — please share the transfer reference and date.

I'm sorry you're having trouble with a declined payment. A decline can happen if there aren't enough available funds, the card is blocked, or the merchant's verification failed. Please check your available balance and try again, or share the date and amount of the transaction so we can look into it further.

I'm sorry the refund hasn't appeared yet. Refunds can take several business days to be processed and posted, depending on when the merchant released it. Please check your recent transactions again in a few days. If it still isn't visible after that time, let us know and we'll look into it for you.

Thank you for reaching out. Refunds can take several business days to appear after the merchant has issued them, so it may not yet be reflected on your statement. If it's been more than the usual processing window, please let us know the merchant name, refund amount, and approximate date, and we'll be happy to check the status for you.

I'm sorry the refund hasn't shown up yet. Refunds can take several business days to appear depending on the merchant and your card issuer. Could you share the date and amount of the original purchase so I can check the status for you? If it's been longer than expected, we can look into tracing it.

I can help you look into that €1.00 charge. It may be a small service or transaction fee, but to confirm, could you tell me the date of the charge, the description shown on your statement, and which account or card it appeared on? Once I have those details, I'll explain what it's for and, if it's an error, guide you on the next steps to dispute it.

I'm sorry your payment didn't go through. Please check that your card is active, has available funds, and that the payment details were entered correctly. If the problem continues, let us know the date, amount, and merchant so we can investigate, and we can also check whether the payment was declined and why.

I'm sorry to hear your new card is being declined. First, please confirm the card is activated, you have sufficient available funds or credit, and your PIN is entered correctly. Also check that the merchant accepts your card type. If declines continue, we can review the card's status and recent decline reasons with you — please share the approximate time and location of the attempted payments so we can investigate.

I'm sorry to hear you'd like to close your account. I can help you with that — for security, we'll need to verify your identity first. Please confirm the last four digits of your account number or your registered phone number, and note that any remaining balance will need to be transferred out before closure. Our team can then guide you through the full process.

If the ATM kept your card, please let us know right away so we can block it to keep your account safe. You can do this in your app under Card > Block card, or call our support line. We can then arrange a replacement card to be sent to you. If you're still at the machine, also check whether the card was returned after a moment, and note the machine's location and time.

I'm sorry to hear that! Please block your card immediately in your app (or by calling us) to keep it safe, and let us know the ATM location and date/time of the incident. We can then report it with the ATM operator and arrange a replacement card for you.

I'm sorry to hear your card was stuck in the ATM. First, check whether the ATM retained your card or simply couldn't return it — if it's still inside the machine, do not attempt to retrieve it manually. Next, block your card immediately to prevent any unauthorized use: you can do this from your mobile app, by logging into online banking, or by calling our 24/7 card services line. Once blocked, you can request a replacement card, and we'll guide you on collecting a temporary card or cash access if needed.

I'm sorry your card was retained by the machine. Please check that no one nearby is acting suspiciously, and do not attempt to use the card again. If the card is not returned shortly, please let us know so we can block it and arrange a replacement; your cash withdrawal will still have been processed and your balance updated accordingly.

You can see where your money came from in the transaction history section of our app or online banking. There, each incoming payment shows the sender or payer, the date, and the amount. If a deposit isn't showing a clear source, please let us know the date and amount, and we'll be happy to help you look into it.

I'm sorry you're seeing a transaction you don't recognise. If money has appeared in your account that you weren't expecting, it could be a refund, a transfer, or interest, but please don't rely on the funds until we've checked. To help me trace the source, could you share the date, amount, and description shown in your transaction history? If it looks like a payment you didn't authorise, please let me know straight away and we'll secure your account.

Of course. You can set a new PIN for your card through your mobile app or online banking under card settings, or by calling the number on the back of your card. For security, please avoid easily guessed numbers and never share your PIN with anyone.

You can change your card PIN in a few ways: 1) At any of our ATMs, insert your card and select 'Change PIN'; 2) Through your mobile or online banking app under Card Services; or 3) By visiting a branch with photo ID. If you've forgotten your current PIN, we can mail a PIN reminder to your registered address, or you can reset it via the app. Is there anything else I can help with?

Thank you for your message. If your GBP salary has already arrived in your account, no further setup is needed on our side — it will simply appear in your account balance and transaction history.

If you would like the salary to be set up as a recurring payment, the sender (your employer) would need to arrange that with us, either as a standing order or as a regular bank transfer. Please note that we are unable to set this up from this chat for security reasons.

If the amount is not showing in your balance, or if you need help verifying the payment, please let us know the date and value of the transfer and we can look into it with you.

I'm sorry to hear your transfer didn't go through. Could you please tell me the date, the amount, and the last four digits of the account or card involved? It's possible the transfer was simply declined or is still pending. We'll check the status and let you know of the next steps.

Thank you for reaching out. It sounds like your cash withdrawal was not completed at the ATM, but the authorisation is still showing as pending. These pending amounts usually drop off automatically once the ATM operator confirms the transaction was not completed, typically within a few business days, and no funds are actually taken in the meantime. If the pending status remains beyond that time or the money is debited from your account, please let us know and we will look into it further for you.

To send money into your account, open the app or log in to online banking, go to Payments or Transfers, and choose the account you'd like the funds to come from. From there, enter the amount and confirm the payment. If you're transferring from an external bank, you'll need our account details (including IBAN/BIC where applicable). If you can't see a transfer option or need specific details for your account, please let us know and we'll help.

A pending transaction is a payment that's been authorized but hasn't fully finished processing yet — it may have been a hold placed at the ATM rather than a completed withdrawal. It will usually drop off on its own within a few business days. I'm not able to cancel a pending item from here, but if it doesn't disappear within that time, please contact us again so we can check its status and, if appropriate, raise a query on your behalf.

To pay by check, write the date, the payee's name, the amount in numbers and words, and sign it, then give the check to the payee. You can also deposit a check you've received by mobile app (endorsing the back and writing "for mobile deposit") or at an ATM/branch, or request a new checkbook from your account if you need one. Please allow time for checks to clear, and keep the check stub or receipt for your records.

Thank you for reaching out. The fee for a physical card depends on the card type and whether it is a new order or a replacement. Please check the pricing section of your account or app for the exact amount, or let us know which card you're referring to and we can provide more detail.

I can help with that. Once your card has been dispatched, we send tracking details by email or text to the contact information on your account. Please check those messages, including your spam folder, for a tracking number. If you can't find it, let us know the date the card was mailed and we'll look into the delivery status for you.

I'm sorry you're having trouble using your disposable virtual card. Please check that the card is still active and hasn't expired, and that the details were entered exactly as shown (number, expiry date, and CVV). If the card has expired, you can generate a new disposable card from your app. If it still won't work, let us know the exact error message and we'll look into it for you.

Our ATMs abroad can dispense your home currency if the machine offers it as an option at the time of withdrawal. If the machine's local operator offers this, you can select your home currency and the conversion will be shown to you before you confirm. Please note that cash withdrawal and foreign currency charges may apply, based on your account terms - you can check the exact fees in your app or on our website. If the machine doesn't offer your home currency, you can withdraw local currency instead, and your bank will convert it at the rate shown. We'd recommend carrying a small amount of local cash as a backup while you're away.

Using a local ATM to withdraw British pounds may incur charges, depending on your account type and the ATM operator. Any applicable fees would be shown to you on the ATM screen before you confirm the withdrawal, so you can review them and decide whether to proceed. If you let us know which account you hold, we can give you more specific information about the charges that apply to you.
Yes, EUR is one of the currencies we can exchange for you. Please note the current exchange rate and any applicable fees will be shown to you before you confirm the transaction.

You can check whether disposable virtual cards are available in your banking app or online banking under Cards > Virtual Cards. If your account supports them, you'll be able to create a one-time-use virtual card there; otherwise, you can order a standard virtual card instead. Please note that availability may depend on your account type and region.

Disposable (virtual) cards typically allow multiple transactions until the card reaches its spending limit or is cancelled. The exact number and any per-transaction or daily limits depend on your card's terms — you can check these in your banking app or card settings, or contact us for the specific limits on your card.

I'm sorry your top-up didn't go through. Common reasons include an incorrect card number or expiry date, insufficient funds, or a temporary hold by your card issuer. Please check those details and try again; if it still fails, let us know the date, amount, and method used so we can look into it.

I'm sorry your top-up didn't go through. Common reasons for a denial include insufficient funds on the source card, daily or transaction limits being reached, an expired or incorrect card number, or the payment being flagged for security checks. Could you confirm the date, approximate amount, and payment method you used? Please also check whether any notification was sent to your app or email. In the meantime, you can retry using another payment method or a smaller amount. If the issue continues, we may need to review the transaction with our payments team, which can take a few working days.

I'm sorry your top-up was declined. This can happen for a few reasons, such as the payment method being expired or unsupported, insufficient funds to complete the transfer, or the amount falling outside our minimum or maximum top-up limits. Please check that your payment details are correct and that the amount is within the allowed limits, then try again. If it still doesn't go through, let us know the approximate date, amount, and payment method used, and we'll look into it with you.

Thanks for reaching out. The timing depends on the transfer type—domestic transfers often arrive within 1–2 business days, while international transfers can take up to 3–5 business days. If you share the transfer details or check your app under recent transactions, you can view its current status. If it's still within the expected timeframe, it should arrive shortly; if it's overdue, please let us know and we'll look into it for you.

I'm sorry for the confusion. To help, could you confirm the date, amount, and location (ATM or branch) of the transaction you don't recognise? We'll review our records for that withdrawal and let you know what we find. If you believe it was made without your permission, please let us know straight away.

You can find our current exchange rates in your banking app or on our website under 'Currency Exchange' or 'Foreign Exchange'. Rates are updated daily and may vary slightly depending on whether you are sending, receiving, or converting currency. If you tell me which currency pair you need, I can point you to the right place.

Top-ups can carry a fee depending on the method used (e.g., debit card, bank transfer, or cash). Please check the fee schedule in the Fees & Limits section of your account or app before topping up, and let us know which method you'd like to use so we can point you to the applicable rate.

Deposits made with an international card may be subject to fees charged by your card issuer, such as foreign transaction or currency conversion fees. Please check the fee schedule for your card and your card provider for the exact charges before making the deposit.

I'd be happy to help you activate your new card. You can usually activate it via our mobile app by selecting your new card and choosing 'Activate card', or by calling the automated activation line on the number printed on your card's sticker. Once activated, you'll also be able to set your PIN. Is there anything else you need help with?

Congratulations on your new card! You can usually activate it through your mobile banking app or online banking, or by using any of our ATMs. If you have any trouble or need assistance, please let us know and we'll be happy to help.

To activate your new card, you can do so through our mobile app or online banking by selecting the card and choosing 'Activate card,' or by calling the automated activation number printed on the card sticker. If you need any help, please let us know and we'll guide you through it.

You can usually activate your card using our mobile app or online banking by selecting the card and choosing "Activate card," or by calling the number printed on the sticker attached to your card. You'll just need your card details and possibly your PIN or ID to confirm. If neither option works, please let us know and we'll help you check other ways to activate it.

I'm sorry about the unexpected charge. A fee can appear if the withdrawal was made at an ATM outside our network or above any free allowance. Please share the date, amount and location of the withdrawal, and I'll check the charge and let you know the reason.

Withdrawal fees are usually applied based on your account type, the ATM or channel used, and any free withdrawal limits included in your plan. Please check your account's fee schedule for the exact charges, or let us know which withdrawal you're referring to and we can help explain it.

Thank you for reaching out. Before your card's expiry date, we'll automatically send a replacement card to your registered address — no action is needed on your part. Once it arrives, you can activate it in your app or by following the instructions included with the card. Your PIN will remain the same unless you've requested a change. If your new card hasn't arrived within a few days of the expiry date, please let us know and we'll be happy to help.

In most cases, a replacement card is automatically issued and sent to you before your current card expires, so you don't need to order a new one. Please ensure your address on file is up to date so the card reaches you in time. If you haven't received a new card a few weeks before expiry, contact us and we'll be happy to help.

We don't offer top-ups through a Google Play app. You can add money to your account via bank transfer, direct deposit, or one of our partner retail locations. Please check the Top Up section in your banking app for the options available to you.

Thanks for reaching out. Not all card issuers allow their cards to be added to Apple Pay, and American Express cards are sometimes restricted depending on the card and region. Please check with American Express to confirm whether your card supports Apple Pay, and ensure your device and Wallet app are fully updated. If your card is supported and still won't add, we're happy to look into it further with you.

Whether Apple Pay is available for top-ups depends on your account type and the top-up method you select. Please check the top-up options in your banking app, where any supported payment methods will be listed.

Yes, you can top up using Apple Pay directly from your Apple Watch, provided your card is set up in the Wallet app and your watch is paired with your iPhone. Simply double-click the side button, select your card, and authorise the payment. If you don't see Apple Pay as an option, please make sure your device and app are up to date, or contact us and we'll be happy to help.

I'd be happy to help with your identity verification. To begin, please open the app or log in to online banking and go to the verification section, where you'll be asked to upload a valid photo ID (passport or driver's licence) and a selfie. Make sure your details match your account information exactly. If you don't see the verification option or the upload fails, let me know what message or error you receive, and we'll look into it.

Thanks for reaching out! Whether your country is supported depends on where you're located — could you share the name of your country? Once I know, I'll be happy to confirm whether we operate there and what options may be available to you.

We can certainly look into faster delivery options for your card. Standard delivery times vary, and expedited shipping may be available for an additional fee depending on your card type and location. Please share the type of card and your delivery address, or visit your nearest branch, and we'll check what options we can offer.

Auto top-up limits vary depending on your card or account type. You can check your current auto top-up settings and any applicable limits in your banking app under the top-up or card settings section, or we can review them for you if you let us know which card or account you mean.

Yes — you can set up a recurring top-up (a standing order) to move money automatically from your current account to your travel card or savings at an interval you choose. You can manage this in Online Banking under Payments › Standing orders, or via the mobile app. If you'd like, tell me which accounts are involved and I'll walk you through the steps.

I'm sorry your card hasn't arrived yet. Two weeks is longer than typical delivery, so I'd recommend checking your account or app to confirm the card was dispatched and that your address is correct, then contacting us so we can trace the delivery and, if needed, arrange for it to be reissued.

Sorry to hear that. Could you tell me where the card was declined (in store, online or at an ATM) and whether you see any block or notification in your app? In the meantime, please check your card's status under Cards in the app — if it shows as blocked or has expired, let us know and we'll help you sort it out.

You can view and convert supported currencies at the current exchange rate directly in the app under Payments or Transfers. If you'd like to make an exchange, let us know the currencies involved and we'll guide you through the steps.

Our app supports foreign currency exchange for a range of major currencies. You can see the full, up-to-date list of available currencies by opening the exchange or transfer section of the app; if a currency you need isn't listed there, please let us know and we'll check what options are available for you.

I'm sorry to hear your wallet was lost. Please block your card immediately using your banking app or by calling our 24/7 card helpline — that is the fastest way to prevent any unauthorized use. Once the card is blocked, a replacement can be ordered through the app, by phone, or at your local branch, and it will typically arrive within 5–7 working days. If you notice any unfamiliar transactions, please report them right away.

I'm sorry your card is missing. For your security, please let us know as soon as possible so we can check its last use and, if needed, freeze or block it. You can do this in your mobile app under Cards, or by calling the number on the back of your card. If it's been lost rather than stolen, we can also help you request a replacement once we've secured it.

Yes — we offer accounts for children. A parent or legal guardian will need to open it with us, providing their own ID and the child's details (such as a birth certificate or proof of guardianship). Please let us know which account type you'd prefer, and we'll walk you through the steps and eligibility requirements.

Thanks for reaching out! Most of our current and savings accounts can be opened from age 11 or 16 depending on the account type, with full adult accounts available from 18. For accounts under 18, a parent or guardian may need to be present and provide ID. You can check the specific age requirements for each account on our website, or visit a branch with valid photo ID and proof of address if you'd like to apply in person.

I'd be happy to help you link an additional card. In your app, go to Cards and select "Add card" or "Link a card," then follow the prompts to enter the card details and verify it (usually with a one-time code sent to your phone or email). If you don't see that option, please let me know which cards you're trying to link (e.g., a card from another account with us) so I can guide you further.

For security reasons, we're unable to display your PIN in messages or emails. You can view or change your PIN securely in the mobile app under Card Settings > Manage PIN. If you've forgotten it, you can set a new PIN there as well, or let us know and we can guide you through the options available.

I'm sorry you're having trouble. Please stop trying additional PIN attempts, as further failures can permanently block your card. You can continue using other payment methods such as contactless or online payments if your card is otherwise active. To have the card unblocked or a new PIN issued, please contact us or visit your nearest branch with a valid ID, and we'll assist you.

You can unblock your PIN at most of our ATMs by inserting your card and following the on-screen instructions, or at any of our branches. If the ATM route doesn't work, please visit a branch with photo ID and we'll help you set a new PIN.

To enable contactless payments, open your mobile banking app, go to Card Settings (or Manage Cards), select your card, and look for the Contactless or Contactless & Mobile Payments option—make sure it is switched on. You can also check under Security Settings to confirm no spending or security limits are blocking contactless transactions. If you don't see the option or it's greyed out, please let us know and we'll be happy to help further.

Sorry to hear your contactless payments aren't going through. Please check that the card isn't damaged, that your phone's NFC is turned on (if paying with a device), and that you hold the card or device steady on the reader for a second or two. Contactless may also be declined if the terminal has a limit, if a higher-value payment requires your PIN first, or if the card has been used many times without a PIN entry. If it still doesn't work, please try inserting the card and entering your PIN, and let us know the error message you see.

Sorry to hear that. Contactless may not work if the card is damaged, dirty, or if the terminal is out of service. Make sure the card is held flat against the reader for a second or two. If it still fails, please let us know so we can check whether a replacement card is needed.

Great news that you've found your card! If it was previously reported as lost or stolen, you'll need a replacement, as the found card will no longer work. To add a card to the app, go to Cards, tap Add Card or Add to Wallet, and follow the prompts to verify your details. If you haven't reported it missing, you can simply activate it in the app under Cards > Activate. If you run into any trouble, let us know and we'll be happy to help.

I'm sorry you're having trouble with contactless payments. Please check that your card is contactless-enabled (look for the contactless symbol), that it isn't expired, and that you're holding it flat against the terminal for a second or two. If it still doesn't work, try inserting the card and entering your PIN, and let us know so we can look into the issue further.

To use contactless payments, tap your card or mobile device on the reader at checkout when you see the contactless symbol. Your card must be contactless-enabled, and purchases up to your card's contactless limit can usually be completed without entering your PIN. If you have trouble, check that your card is held flat against the reader or try inserting the card instead.

Not exactly a regular payment, but you may need to use your card in the machine and enter your PIN at least once before contactless payments will work. This is a security check we ask for on new cards (and sometimes after the card has been in use for a while or not used at contactless terminals for some time). After that one PIN transaction, you should be able to pay contactless as normal. If it still doesn't work after a PIN transaction, please let us know and we can look into it.

I'm glad you found your card! If it was already reported lost, it has been permanently deactivated for security and cannot be reactivated — a replacement card will need to be issued instead. If you haven't reported it lost yet, please let us know so we can check its status and help you with the next steps.

Card top-ups can sometimes take a few business days to clear, depending on your card issuer. Please check the transaction status in your app or account statement. If it hasn't been credited after 5–7 business days, let us know and we can look into it with the payment details (date, amount, and last four digits of the card).

I'm sorry you're experiencing this delay. Pending top-ups can sometimes take a short while to process, even when your card is working correctly. Please allow a little time for it to clear; if it remains pending, we may need to check the status of the transaction or your card details.

Thank you for reaching out. Top-ups can sometimes take a little longer to appear depending on the payment method and the time of day it was made. If it has been more than a few working days, please check that the payment was completed and any reference number matches your account. If it still isn't showing, please share the date, amount, and reference of the top-up so we can investigate further.

A pending status means your top-up has been received but hasn't been credited to your account yet. This is normal and can take a short while to complete, depending on the payment method and your bank's processing times. Please wait for it to be processed, and if it hasn't updated after a few working days, contact us and we'll check it for you.

You can top up using our mobile app, online banking, or by visiting a branch. Please note that top-up amounts are subject to daily and per-transaction limits. If you'd like to request a limit increase, our team can review this for you — please visit a branch with valid ID or contact us by phone.

I'm sorry your transaction didn't go through. Failed transactions are often caused by insufficient funds, incorrect card details, or a temporary security block, and the hold is usually released within a few working days. Could you share the date, amount, and payment method so I can look into what happened? In the meantime, please check your available balance and try the payment again.

Transfers between our members are usually instant, but depending on the recipient's bank, they can sometimes take up to 1 business day to clear. The money is on its way, so your friend should receive it shortly. If it hasn't arrived by then, please let us know and we can look into the transfer status for you.

Thank you for letting us know. You can add and pay with another eligible card in your account settings under "Top up" or "Payment methods." Please note that only cards in your own name are accepted, and any limits or fees will be shown before you confirm the payment. If the card isn't accepted, please let us know the exact message you receive.

Deposits and withdrawals can be made in the currencies supported by your account (for example GBP, EUR and USD). The exact currencies accepted can vary by branch or ATM, so please check the details shown in your app or contact us before visiting so we can confirm what's available for your account.

A virtual card is a digital version of your debit or credit card that exists only in your banking app — there's no plastic card. It has its own card number, expiry date, and security code, and can be used for online and contactless payments, often with the option to freeze it instantly or generate single-use numbers for added security. If you'd like one issued, please let us know and we can guide you through the process.
